t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Orange, red, blue and green gnomes will take me to a bright forest and I'll have a red basket. Yellow, Pink, purple and brown gnomes will take me to a dark forest and I'll have a yellow basket. I need to determine which forest seems to have the most mushrooms and then try to quickly pick a gnome associated with said forest, to collect the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Hi! I hope this advice is helpful to you. I learned from someone else who had completed the game that the gnomes are shown in pairs. In each round, one gnome will lead you to a brighter, lush forest and the other gnome will take you to a darker forest. You will have a yellow basket in the dark forest and a red basket in the bright forest. The gnomes who lead you to the bright forest are a hot pink-reddish one (who always shows up in a pair with the yellow gnome), the blue gnome, the green gnome and the orange gnome. The gnomes that will lead you to the dark forest are the brown gnomes (who is always paired with an orange gnome), a light pink gnome, a yellow gnome and a purple gnome. If it helps, the purple gnome is always shown as a choice against the blue gnome and the light pink gnome is always a choice against the green gnome. I couldn't really figure out what the secret is to picking the best forest but I'm giving you all the information I can think of that could be helpful. I did find that the purple gnome seemed to get me a lot of points most of the time but it did seem as though going to the brighter forest yielded me higher mushroom counts, but it varied enough that it made me think it's not as simple as that.
